# Camp Resource: Budding Apothecary Collector

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Feb 19, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Aug 7, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a3626aa871844e088bffd1daa21b67f6~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

Try to find that seed you are looking for with the Budding Apothecary machine.

Generates Flora

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Budding Apothecary Collector__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cca3708251f8415a9fa7754511af4776~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Flora

**Drop List**

- Ash Rose
- Aster
- Black Bloodleaf
- Bloodleaf
- Carrot Flower
- Mutated Fern Flower
- Fever Blossom
- Gourd Blossom
- Kaleidopore Flower
- Melon Bloom
- Melon Blossom
- Rhododendron Flower
- Soot Flower
- Strangler Bloom
- Strangler Pod
- Tato Flower
- Thistle
- Toxic Soot Flower

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

4 Flora

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Budding Apothecary Station__ - 700 atoms

Atom Shop - __Pioneer Summer C.A.M.P Bundle__ - 1500 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Drop Rate**

5.56%

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
